<h2 id="Anderson-2015-%E2%80%94-Rare-biosphere-diversity">Anderson 2015 — Rare biosphere diversity<a class="anchor-link" href="#Anderson-2015-%E2%80%94-Rare-biosphere-diversity">¶</a></h2><p>Synthetic vent communities (<strong>Piccard</strong>, <strong>Von Damm</strong>, <strong>background seawater</strong>) illustrate how dominance vs evenness shifts Shannon, Simpson, Chao1, and pairwise Bray–Curtis dissimilarity.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered">
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_png output_subarea">
<img alt="No description has been provided for this image" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="Anderson-2014-%E2%80%94-Viral-metagenomics-/-Nei%E2%80%93Gojobori-dN/dS">Anderson 2014 — Viral metagenomics / Nei–Gojobori dN/dS<a class="anchor-link" href="#Anderson-2014-%E2%80%94-Viral-metagenomics-/-Nei%E2%80%93Gojobori-dN/dS">¶</a></h2><p>Standard codon table; per-codon <strong>synonymous vs nonsynonymous site</strong> counts averaged over single-nucleotide neighbors; substitutions classified along averaged pathways for multi-hit codons. <strong>Jukes–Cantor</strong> correction yields <em>d<sub>S</sub></em> and <em>d<sub>N</sub></em>; ω = <em>d<sub>N</sub></em>/<em>d<sub>S</sub></em>.</p>
<p>Interpret ω: <strong>&lt;1</strong> purifying selection, <strong>&gt;1</strong> positive selection, <strong>≈1</strong> neutral.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

Nonsynonymous: dN=0.6355, dS=0.0000, ω=∞
Mixed: dN=0.0000, dS=inf, ω=0.0000
</pre>
</div>
